Transit logistics demand the same precision as your workshop bench. 

When high-value inventory moves between scheduled premises or to approved third-party locations such as trade shows, the exposure changes. Standard commercial policies rarely account for the specific custody and security chain required for fine jewellery.

Jade underwrites jewellers block risks specifically for the Singapore trade. Our policy covers stock at scheduled premises and in transit, extending cover to goods in transit between scheduled premises and approved third-party locations such as trade shows, subject to the security arrangements and transit limits set out in the policy schedule.

When an insured loss occurs, Jade settles claims based on the valuation basis set out in the policy schedule, following proper underwriting assessment.

Review your transit limits with a specialist who understands the trade.

examples.claim_or_topic: protecting jewellery inventory held in store overnight
examples.english_source:
The security warranty in your schedule defines the boundary of your cover.

For independent jewellers in Singapore, leaving high-value inventory on display after hours is not simply a matter of store protocol; it is a structural underwriting condition. 

Standard jewellers block policies require strict adherence to safe and alarm warranties. If stock remains outside a certified, locked safe overnight without meeting the specific security criteria outlined in your policy schedule, the resulting exposure sits outside the terms of cover. 

Precision in risk management starts with aligning your daily closing procedures directly with your policy parameters. When the safe is locked and the premises secured according to schedule, your stock at scheduled premises remains properly protected.

Understand the mechanics of your warranty. Review your schedule to ensure your overnight storage practices match your underwriting terms.

保险凭证上的安全条款，界定了您保障范围的边界。

对于本地的独立珠宝商而言，打烊后将高价值货品留在展柜中，不仅是店铺的日常常规，更是核保的硬性条件。

标准的珠宝商综合险（Jewellers Block）要求严格遵守保险柜及警报器的相关承诺。如果未按保单附表列明的安全标准执行，将存货在夜间置于认证且上锁的保险柜之外，由此产生的风险将不在保障范围之内。

风险管理的精准性，始于将每日的打烊流程与保单条款紧密契合。当保险柜上锁、店面按规定妥善安防，您在保单指定地点的存货方能获得妥当的保障。

明晰保单条款的运作机制。请仔细核对您的保单附表，确保夜间存放的实际操作符合核保要求。
